phase: Place-axis candidate comparison. Four seeds per candidate so each candidate carries its OWN resampling floor, which v3 could not do.
primary: Pre-registered primary outcome is the plan, not the money: (a) share of cells whose plan puts an offline purchase at a zone anchor - the only place a restricted wallet applies, measured at 0-2 of 12 in v3; (b) time-insensitive plan distance between arms, read against this candidate's own same-arm floor. Money metrics are secondary and underpowered at 12 people.
limitations: Twelve people. Four seeds raise precision for THESE twelve, not generalisation to a population.
Distancing cells have no cafe or late dining in any observed plan, so that arm may stay unscorable.
Responding is necessary, not sufficient: moving more is not the same as moving correctly.
Adds one axis: choosing WHERE an existing need is met. Nothing else differs.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed set v25/v28 fixed before the run (experiments/v4/prompt_v4.md). v28 differs from v25 on one axis only, enforced by test_where_axis_candidate.py.
